name: Mr Ronald Gesigonimo Napitalai
credentials: FIEPNG, CPEng · B.Eng (Civil), PNG University of Technology · PG Dip. Civil Engineering
bio:
Mr Napitalai has more than 22 years of engineering consultancy experience in project management and structural engineering. He graduated from the PNG University of Technology with a Bachelor of Engineering (Civil) in 1990 and a Postgraduate Diploma in Civil Engineering in 1991.

He began his career in 1992 with Kinhill Kramer as a civil engineer. With Kinhill Kramer and Rumbam Gapi he carried out structural design of industrial structures and multi-storey buildings, the foundation for what became R. Napitalai Limited.
